vectors.name: the Flight Planning Essentials pack of content-index#117 passes
vectors.pack:
spec_version = 1
id = "beiks-flight-planning-essentials-pack"
type = "modpack"
name = "Flight Planning Essentials"
authors = ["Beik"]
version = "1.0.0"
released_at = "2026-09-23T20:00:00Z"
abstract = "This is a small pack of three mods for mission planning: one for looking up bodies in the solar system, one for delta-v budgets and transfer windows, and one for executing maneuvers."
description = """
Included mods:

Compendium v0.9.13 by nanonestor
Adds a window, toggled through ModMenu, that lists the bodies in the loaded solar system.

* Bodies are grouped by category, with moons listed under their parent body
* Orbit lines can be toggled for a single body, a group or a whole category
* Each body has a page of stats

Forum: https://forums.ahwoo.com/forums/kitten-space-agency/mod-releases/compendium.647/
SpaceDock: https://spacedock.info/mod/4074/Compendium
(MIT license)


DeltaVMap v1.2.6 by Maxi
An interactive delta-v subway map and transfer-window planner. The map is built from the loaded solar system, so it works with stock and modded systems without setup.

* The map is centered on your current body, and transfers use Hohmann calculations
* Route planning shows the delta-v for each leg and compares the total with your vehicle's delta-v
* Transfer windows show the optimal phase angle, the current phase and time to the next window
* Open it from View → Delta-V Map in flight, or from its tab in the editor

Forum: https://forums.ahwoo.com/threads/deltavmap.978/
SpaceDock: https://spacedock.info/mod/4294/DeltaVMap
(MIT license)


Advanced Flight Computer v0.8.0 by Maxi
Maneuver planning, burn execution and closed-loop guidance.

* Quick tools for common maneuvers, plus flyby targeting (hyperbolic orbits supported)
* Burns can be split across multiple passes, or run on RCS only
* Automatic staging, including spent boosters
* Powered guidance for ascent, boostback and landing

Forum: https://forums.ahwoo.com/threads/advanced-flight-computer.783/
SpaceDock: https://spacedock.info/mod/4253/AdvancedFlightComputer
(MIT license)


Requirements
* KSA 2026.9.10.5438 or newer
* StarMap loader 0.4.6 or newer
* Recommended: ModMenu
* Optional: KittenExtensions (enables some AFC features)

Installation
1. Open Borea Mod Manager
2. Find Flight Planning Essentials under Mod Packs
3. Install. Borea installs the three mods and their dependencies.

Credits and support All credit goes to the mod authors. Report bugs in a mod on its own tracker, and problems with the pack in this thread.
"""
